summary: HERØY KOMMUNE VERKSEMDSTYRING (org. no. 974 781 999) is an organisational unit (ORGL) based in Herøy, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-09-01. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 84.120 (Offentlig administrasjon tilknyttet helsestell, undervisning, kultur og annen sosial virksomhet); it has 24 registered employees. CEO: Trond Arne Rossi Aglen.
